lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 fixed the specifyIssueOnMain call example in cam-spec.md (both .claude/ and templates/ trees). The old example had three bugs: (1) passed a non-existent `issuesPath` field, (2) omitted required `cwd`, `spawnFn`, and `clock` options, (3) used `await` on a synchronous function. The corrected example now shows: import from issue-specify.ts and node:child_process, a synchronous call to specifyIssueOnMain with cwd/id/spec/wsjf/spawnFn/clock, and no await. bun run embed-vendor was re-run; _generated.ts is current. Both review-round-1 fix stories (US-R1-001 and US-R1-002) now pass. All non-operator stories pass (US-001 through US-008, US-R1-001, US-R1-002). US-009 remains operator-required (grill ceremony). The supervisor should route to review round 2 or cam-review.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-R1-002 is a documentation-only fix (cam-spec.md example correction). No external library was exercised.
